non_material_topics.Explanation: The main disclosures required in 11.7 are not relevant for our business. However, we operate service stations and depots. When closed we set aside financial provisions for closure and rehabilitation. Our financial provisions (11.7.6) are reported in the Annual Report 2023–2024.

The main disclosures required in 11.14 relates to how OK-Q8 AB affects economic systems connected to procurements practices and employment of workers. Our operations at local, national and global level are not material enough to have that type of impact.

The main disclosures required in 11.15 relates to community engagement programmes and operations with significant negative impacts on local communities. We operate service stations and depots all over Denmark and Sweden. These are dependent on permits from local authorities.
Land and resource rights are not material to OK-Q8 AB focusing on the marketing and sale of oil and gas.
Given our type of business, marketing and sale of oil and gas, the rights of indigenous people are not identified as material.
We operate in Denmark and Sweden and we do not use security personnel.
Payments to governments in addition to what is legally required is not part of OK-Q8 AB’s business.
Public policy in this sense is not material for OK-Q8 AB.
